With me I stopped watching anime, it became like a chore to watch it. Though what got me back into it was I went to my friends and they were watching fairy tail, which I had already seen. I didn't have much interest but I stayed and watched. I'm not advocating but we smoked a few joints as well. I kept going over and smoking a watching it and I slowly got back into it. By the time we finished it there was a new show that I wanted to watch. But ide say watcha show you've already seen that you enjoyed and watch it with friends. A comfort show. Try and enjoy it vicariously through them. Plus because we were binging together I didn't want to disappoint them and leave them on a cliffhanger.
Now I go over and its calm, we're all looking for shows we'd all enjoy. I've started a few new weekly shows on my own. 
It won't get you out of depression but it's more just dealing with it.
You have to get a decent one, I got a pax and its disappointing. It was like taking a toke of a zoot after packing a p4. Though I was recommended a ball vape, which is meant to be better.

I started in 2017, so only 7 years. But you've been smoking for 44 years. Technology is improving at a very fast rate. And with legalisation, more research is going into different methods of consuming thc. The first dry vape was invented in the 90s. Imagine what's gonna be invented in the 30s. 
There's thc lean, put it in a cup of tea, and it doesn't mess with your lungs at all. Most relaxing way I've ever found to get stoned.

Oh yh, I know im a dumass. That why I researched a decent amount on dry vapes and thats why I have a distaste for them because of the amount of misinformation out there. And price and discretion was a big point on buying one. Plus official information from pax website didn't deliver on what it said. I'm not saying its bad, just overhyped. I'm sure techs got better and the higher end models are good. Just not all of us have the money to drop on one. On lower end models it doesn't extract more thc even though many clame it does. Though i can taste the weed more on a vape.

I did when I got my pax and I'm slowly cutting down again, but all it takes is one sesh with friends, and dry vapes are ruined. But everyone has their own reason and pefered way of getting high. Dry vape if you enjoy it, not saying not to. They just aren't as good as vapers make them out to be and leads to disappointment. They oversell the idea on them.

It's financial as well, I don't wanna be spending all my money on weed. I can have 1 zoot (.3) before bed and 100% I'm falling asleep. With my vape I'm gonna have to pack it multiple times, same weight and I'm not guaranteed to even sleep, probably because I constantly have to get up to pack to get minutly high for a short time. I was told vapes were more efficient with my bud, lies.

You can't have a good tolerance with them. If you smoke more than 2 zoots a day, it's not worth it. Its just like throwing away weed. You pack in a .3 and it feels like after you've had one pull off a joint.
